subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Should deterministic sub-agent announce suppression be exposed as a narrow per-spawn `sessions_spawn` option, an `agents.defaults.subagents` config default, both with precedence rules, or folded into the broader `announceTarget` routing design?
rationale: Current source has an internal suppression seam, but choosing a public tool/config contract affects compatibility, docs, channel precedence, and related orchestration requests; automation should not pick that policy unilaterally.

options.title: Per-spawn suppression first
options.body: Expose a default-preserving `sessions_spawn` suppression policy and defer global/per-channel defaults until maintainers settle the broader config shape.

options.title: Config plus per-spawn override
options.body: Add `agents.defaults.subagents` policy and a per-call override together, with explicit precedence, docs, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Fold into routing design
options.body: Resolve this under the broader parent/channel routing tracker so `skip`, `parent`, and channel delivery share one public enum contract.

recommendation.title: Per-spawn suppression first
recommendation.body: Expose a default-preserving `sessions_spawn` suppression policy and defer global/per-channel defaults until maintainers settle the broader config shape.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the strongest available routing candidate from current blame, prior canonical issue review, and historical `sessions_spawn`/announce ownership signals.
